name: Keralam Museum of History and Heritage
summary: Keralam is a museum of Kerala's history and heritage in Thiruvananthapuram, set up by the Government of Kerala in 2011 as an autonomous body under the Department of Cultural Affairs. It is open 10 am to 5.30 pm on working days except Mondays and public holidays.
highlights: Established by the Government of Kerala in 2011
Also known as the Interactive Museum of Cultural History of Kerala
Open 10 am to 5.30 pm, closed Mondays and public holidays
Has led the refurbishment of other Kerala museums, including the Hill Palace at Thripunithura
